If your output vanished for a full year, what part of you would you finally have to sit still with — and why have you been outrunning it?
adventures: Take the same long walk at the same time every day for the whole season. No headphones, no shortcuts, no skipping for weather. When it gets boring — and it will — that's the rep. Keep walking.
Draw the floor plan of your next year on one sheet of paper: a room each for work, people, rest, and one locked door. Build nothing today. Just make the plan clear enough for a stranger to follow.

holiday.name: TOTAL lunar eclipse in Cancer — New Year's Eve blood moon
holiday.action: A THINK day in Capricorn season — THE LONG GAME.

soulQuestions: TOTAL lunar eclipse tonight — the Moon turns to blood in Cancer while the Sun stands in Capricorn: home eclipsed opposite empire, for seventy-one minutes. As the world counts down, ask yourself — what in your life just got eclipsed out, and what structure is left standing in the dark, proven? Walk into 2029 able to answer.
What would your life gain if the thing you're rushing arrived exactly on time instead of early enough to quiet your fear?
adventures: Pick one thing you want right now — the purchase, the answer, the decision. Set a seven-day timer and write the date down. Until it rings: no chasing it, no checking on it, no mentioning it.
Give one clear instruction today — at work, at home, anywhere — then do not explain it, defend it, or apologize for it. Say it once. Let it stand in the room by itself.
